title: What HR Advisory engines or modules are available?
text: HR Tek Systems offers the following advisory engines: HR Tech Maturity Assessment, Digital Roadmap Generator, HCM Vendor Fit Engine, Shared Services Operating Model Planner, and Emotionally Intelligent Change Management.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf (Consolidated Pricing Structure)

title: Can I start for free and what does the Starter plan include?
text: Yes. The Starter plan is freemium (₹0 annual fee) for organizations with fewer than 250 employees and includes dashboard access only.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf (Consolidated Pricing Structure)

title: Which subscription tier should I choose based on employee size?
text: Subscription tiers are based on employee size: Starter (<250), Growth (250–750), Standard (751–1500), Professional (1501–5000), Enterprise (5001–20,000), and Global (20,000+).
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf (Consolidated Pricing Structure)

title: Do subscription plans include any engines for free?
text: Yes. Growth includes 1 free engine, Standard includes 2, Professional includes 3, Enterprise includes all engines, and Global includes all engines plus advisory support. Starter includes dashboard access only.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf (Consolidated Pricing Structure)

title: Can I purchase a single report without subscribing?
text: Yes. Clients on free or basic plans can purchase individual reports using standalone per-module pricing without taking an annual subscription.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf (Consolidated Pricing Structure)

title: What are the standalone prices for individual reports?
text: Standalone report prices are: HR Tech Maturity Assessment ₹40,000; Digital HR Roadmap Generator ₹45,000; HCM Vendor Fit Engine ₹35,000; Shared Services Planner ₹45,000; EI Change Management ₹45,000. A combo of all five modules is priced at ₹1,85,000.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf (Consolidated Pricing Structure)

title: How is billing handled and what payment methods are supported?
text: Subscription plans are billed annually. Individual reports and add-ons are pay-per-use and can be paid via Razorpay, UPI, Net Banking, or Invoice. Payment is due within 7 days of invoice. All prices are exclusive of GST (18%).
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf (Consolidated Pricing Structure)

title: What is the refund policy?
text: Refunds are offered only in cases of technical failure or billing error.
source: HR Tek Systems- Pricing Structure.pdf (Consolidated Pricing Structure)
